author: Doom130
quote: Rockstar deserves to fail because, with GTA 6, they have ruined a legendary video game franchise by creating a game with a completely forgettable protagonist and a ridiculous storyline, riddled with bugs and limitations. And the worst part is that critics are praising it as if it were a flawless masterpiece, giving it near-perfect **** gaming journalists who handed out such ridiculously high ratings would be better off working the fields or swinging pickaxes in the mines instead of writing **** and lying to their readers.
